```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
library(dlookr)
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
```

```{r}
DF <- read_csv("synthetic_dog_breed_health_data.csv")
DF <- janitor::clean_names(DF) #%>% 
  
DF <- DF %>% mutate_if(is.character, as.factor) %>%
  dplyr::select(-synthetic) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "id")

short_DF <- DF[sample(nrow(DF), 1000), ]


```

```{r}
imputate_na(.data = DF, var, method = i_method)
```
